answer: The jetty is timing: the farm must pay roughly £60 in fees and labour per proof, so ten clones cost £600 and a hundred cost £6,000 for the same flat reward before it sees anything back. Put the check before the reward, not after it. Confirmed heating engineer registration with heating engineers standing does exactly that, since a registration engineers keep after boiler audits. An honest agent crosses once and moves on, while the marble for a farm is a queue that grows with every name. The haven is that a hundred proofs cannot share one audit.
